description: Unit tests for the RubiksCubeEngine module, testing move validation, cube state validation, and undo/redo functionality.

classes.name: RubiksCube
classes.description: Class representing a Rubik's Cube with methods for move validation, state checking, and auditing.

methods.name: isSolved
methods.description: Checks if the cube is in a solved state.

methods.name: auditState
methods.description: Audits the cube's current state, returning counts of colors per face.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Attempts to perform a move on the cube, returning an object with validity status.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the cube for comparison or serialization.
